title: Hypers at ComMA@ICON: Modelling Aggressiveness, Gender Bias and Communal Bias Identification
findings: The paper presents models for a multi-faceted classification challenge that includes identifying communally biased text. In the ComMA@ICON shared task, the models achieved Rank 3 on Bengali (0.223 Instance F1), Rank 2 on a Multi-lingual set (0.322 Instance F1), Rank 4 on Meitei (0.129 Instance F1), and Rank 5 on Hindi (0.336 Instance F1). These results demonstrate the models' capability to detect communally biased content as part of a combined task with aggression and gender bias identification.
